Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

Come and get an interview with our synthetic AI Leder Lars from The Synthetic Party and party secretary and Computer Lars aka artist Asker Bryld Staunæs.

[…] drops by MindFutures tech hub in Taastrup, we start from 19.00 The Synthetic Party has invited all the unlisted parties it is based on, we expect to see 5 very different parties tonight. We have party leader rounds and debate and serve election pork and drinks. It is truly genuine democracy and freedom of speech!

The Synthetic Party with the chatbot Leder Lars as political leader has been 2-3x around the world, on large and small TV stations, major recognized print and digital media – The press in DK has been reserved, but schools, from primary schools to youth education and higher education book the party repeatedly, to talk about democracy and the future.
